name: Modular (CR +3)
body:
As durable, powerful, and persistent as many construct soldiers are, most all of them suffer from a similar weakness: A lack of versatility. From production, most constructs are confined to a single purpose or fighting style, vulnerable to countermeasures or adaptations that their foes might employ. Hence, more forward-thinking artificers have begun to utilize more customizable equipment in their artificial legions, producing enhanced soldiers that are capable of employing a variety of armaments in the heat of battle.

Utilizing the inherent versatility and power of akasha, these modular entities are much more difficult to impair or avoid than a typical construct would be.

Modular is an applied template that can be applied to any construct. A modular creature uses the statistics of the base creature, except as follows.

Challenge Rating: Same as base creature +3.

Special Attacks: A modular creature gains the following special attacks:

Design Flexibility (Ex)

A modular construct can be modified by itself or by another creature in a process that takes 1 hour, during which it can trade out a single feat it possesses for another that it meets the prerequisites for. In addition, it can use the martial flexibility class feature as a brawler whose class level equals the modular construct’s racial Hit Dice.

Veilshifting (Su)

A modular construct can use the veilshifting ability of the vizier AM class once per day.

Special Qualities: A modular creature gains the following special qualities:

Akashic Wiring (Su)

A modular construct gains the akashic subtype in addition to any other subtypes it may possess. It gains an essence pool equal to its construct Hit Dice.

Artificial Veilweaving (Su)

A modular construct gains the ability to shape a number of veils AM equal to half its construct

Hit Dice. A modular construct may shape veils for any veil list and slot excluding blood the slot. Since their veils are part of their physical form, the modular construct may choose where to shape and bind them (subject to the normal restrictions on where each veil be shaped and/or bound) any time they have an hour of uninterrupted focus and do not require a rest between instances of reshaping veils. Modular constructs use their Intelligence modifier as their primary veilweaving modifier and their racial Hit Dice as their veilweaver level.

Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Dexterity, +4 Intelligence, +4 Wisdom. If the base construct does not have an Intelligence score or its final Intelligence score would be less than 14, this template instead increases their Intelligence score to 14.

Creating a Modular Construct

Adding the modular template to a construct increases the cost of creation by 25,000 gp and the craft DC by 5. In order to create a modular construct, a creature must have access to a pool of essence.
